title: Primes
description: Numbers that nothing divides but one and themselves. There are infinitely many, and they thin out as 1 / ln N. Unlocks the Sieve of Eratosthenes.

puzzle.goal: Write roughly how many primes there are up to x.
puzzle.name: Gauss estimate
puzzle.ask: Find π for x = @{x} (there are really 168).
puzzle.method: Near x, about one number in ln x is prime; up to x that makes about x / ln x of them.
